beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reviewers would examine whether its relationships are supported, uncertain, analogous, or merely asserted.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Fluent wording cannot serve as the standard for whether a bridge is justified.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nor should every act of synthesis be counted as an error.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader is invited to evaluate a research design that must preserve legitimate explanatory connections.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful new term must earn its place beside concepts already available.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks whether the proposed pattern has distinctive predictions or practical diagnostic value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Behavioral testing could identify an output tendency without establishing one internal mechanism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: More specific causal claims would require stronger and differently designed evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The conclusion leaves open whether a reliable detector could separate good bridges from bad ones.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These unresolved questions make the book an exploratory investigation rather than a completed theory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The supporting material preserves the conversation and extends the analysis into a research protocol.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That record lets readers compare the interpretation with the actual sequence of responses.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also makes disagreement possible at particular steps rather than at the slogan level.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can ask which transition was unsupported and what evidence would have justified it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book's value lies partly in making its own explanatory choices available for inspection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A convincing critique should therefore be able to challenge this account as well.
